notes: Unoptimised build (solc 0.8.7 noopt), yet a compact and readable text. Loop map: configurePool (functionIds loop), hasPermission (lenders loop), setLenderAllowlist (stor4[poolManager][lender] = bool, with the Panic(50) bound on the booleans array, after 'PPM:PAUSED', 'PPM:NOT_PD_GOV_OR_OA', 'PPM:SLA:NO_LENDERS' and 'PPM:SLA:LENGTH_MISMATCH'), setLenderBitmaps, setPoolBitmaps — all checked against the source. The other three whiles are the ABI encode loops of the LenderAllowlistSet / LenderBitmapsSet event arrays (P7). P8: the mem[0]/mem[32] hash scratch writes kept before each nested-mapping write. Calls to globals (isFunctionPaused(msg.sig), the pool delegate / governor / operational admin lookups) are typed but unnamed (unknownXXXXXXXX), which is the signature database.
summary: Faithful and readable: all five source loops are clean whiles; only hash scratch writes and ABI encode loops add noise.
